name: MovingAverageMartinGale
summary: This EA trades based on a simple moving average crossover with price, opening buy or sell positions when the MA crosses above or below the candle close. It employs a Martingale position sizing strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade while also multiplying TP and SL distances, and resetting to initial values after a winning trade.
summary_zh: 该EA基于简单移动平均线与价格的交叉进行交易，当MA向上或向下穿越收盘价时开仓买入或卖出。它采用马丁格尔仓位管理策略，每次亏损后将手数翻倍并同步扩大止盈止损距离，盈利后则重置为初始值。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于移动平均线与价格的交叉：当MA从上方穿越到价格下方时做多，从下方穿越到价格上方时做空，本质上是一个趋势跟踪信号。入场条件是在新K线形成时检测MA与前期收盘价和当前收盘价的交叉关系。出场条件采用固定点数的止盈和止损，初始TP为100点、SL为300点，风险收益比为1:3。仓位管理采用马丁格尔策略：亏损后手数乘以2倍（最高不超过0.5手），盈利后重置为起始手数0.01手。资金管理方面，TP和SL距离也会随马丁格尔倍数同步放大，这导致每次加仓的风险敞口呈指数增长，存在爆仓的严重风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a moving average crossover with price: it goes long when the MA crosses above the price and goes short when it crosses below, essentially a trend-following signal. Entry conditions are triggered on a new candle when the MA value at shift 1 crosses over the previous close and current close prices. Exit conditions use fixed-point take profit and stop loss, with initial TP of 100 points and SL of 300 points, resulting in a risk-reward ratio of 1:3. Position sizing follows a Martingale approach: after a loss, the lot size is multiplied by 2 (capped at 0.5 lots), and after a win, it resets to the starting lot of 0.01. Money management is flawed because both TP and SL distances are also multiplied by the same factor, meaning each successive losing trade exponentially increases the total risk exposure, creating a dangerous path toward account blow-up.

parameters.name: TPMultiplier
parameters.description: 亏损后止盈止损距离乘数
parameters.description_en: TP/SL distance multiplier after a loss

pros: 马丁格尔手数有MaxLot上限保护，防止无限加仓
盈利后自动重置手数和止盈止损，锁定利润回到初始状态
在新K线形成时才交易，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
使用CheckVolumeValue验证手数有效性，防止无效订单
pros_en: Martingale lot sizing has a MaxLot cap to prevent unlimited position increase
Automatically resets lot size and TP/SL after a profitable trade, locking in gains
Trades only on new candle formation, avoiding repeated entries within the same bar
Uses CheckVolumeValue to validate lot size before placing orders
cons: 马丁格尔策略本质危险，连续亏损后风险敞口呈指数增长，极易爆仓
TP和SL距离随马丁格尔倍数同步扩大，后期单笔亏损金额巨大
没有最大连续亏损次数限制，也没有账户权益回撤保护
止损是止盈的3倍，即使不加仓每次交易的期望值也是负的
MA交叉信号滞后严重，容易在震荡行情中频繁假突破导致连续亏损
cons_en: Martingale strategy is inherently dangerous; exponential risk growth after consecutive losses can easily blow the account
TP and SL distances scale with the Martingale multiplier, making individual losses enormous in later stages
No maximum consecutive loss limit and no account equity drawdown protection
Stop loss is 3x the take profit, so even without position scaling each trade has negative expected value
MA crossover signals are heavily lagging, prone to frequent false breakouts in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 添加最大马丁格尔步数限制和账户回撤保护，超过阈值后停止加仓或平仓
将TP/SL距离与手数倍增解耦，只增加手数而不扩大止损距离，控制单笔最大风险
添加趋势过滤器和震荡识别机制，避免在横盘行情中频繁开仓
improvements_en: Add a maximum Martingale step limit and account drawdown protection to stop scaling or close positions when thresholds are breached
Decouple TP/SL distance scaling from lot multiplier — only increase lot size without widening stop loss to cap per-trade risk
Add a trend filter and ranging market detection to avoid frequent entries during sideways conditions

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略导致连续亏损后风险敞口指数增长，后期单笔亏损可能远超账户承受能力
止损距离同步倍增放大了每笔交易的实际亏损金额
1:3的风险收益比配合马丁格尔策略，在趋势反转时可能产生灾难性亏损
risk_points_en: Martingale strategy causes exponential risk growth after consecutive losses; later-stage single-trade losses can far exceed account capacity
Stop loss distance scaling multiplies the actual monetary loss per trade
1:3 risk-reward ratio combined with Martingale can produce catastrophic losses during trend reversals
